integrity: All stated formulas follow from a universal mathematical proof, supplemented by finite independent checks. No external independent audit has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: The proof uses Fernandes–Paulista Lemma 1.1 on dihedral restrictions; enumerations are checked only for bounded sizes. An inaccessible 2022 thesis on related monoids remains a literature-coverage risk. The result does not classify products or centralizers.
title: Rank distribution of self-inverse partial isometries of finite cycles
